zh: 修正智能資產組合分享海報中「具體怎麼買」等長文字卡片會因 2×2 半寬排版而截掉最後一行的問題。
長購買建議改為全寬縱向資訊條，並按文字長度自動分配卡片高度；同時提高購買建議區在海報中的垂直空間。
新增段落型自適應排版：完整句子不再設定固定 `maxLines` 或使用省略號，而是依卡片實際可用高度自動縮放字號，優先保證所有內容完整顯示。
加入長文字海報回歸測試，專門檢查智能組合購買建議不會再以 ellipsis 截掉最後一行；完整 Flutter 回歸與相關靜態分析均通過。
en: Fixed Smart Portfolio share-poster cards where long “How to buy” instructions could lose their final line inside the previous 2×2 half-width grid.
Long purchase instructions now use full-width stacked rows with height allocation based on copy length, and the purchase section receives more vertical space on the poster.

Added paragraph-aware auto fitting: full-sentence guidance no longer relies on fixed `maxLines` or ellipsis, and instead scales text to the real card height so the complete recommendation stays visible.
Added a regression test specifically covering long Smart Portfolio poster guidance to prevent final-line truncation. Full Flutter regression and targeted static analysis pass.
